env.name: DB_PASSWORD
env.description: Postgres password. Never change it after the first deploy.

env.name: CRON_SECRET
env.description: Protects cache clearing, seeding and scheduled jobs

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.description: The address the admin and preview answer on, e.g. https://kit-demo.hosait.com (no trailing /)

env.name: STAGING_HOST
env.description: Only for several sites: the Hosait address whose subdomains serve the other sites

env.name: SITE_ORIGINS
env.description: Set to production when the site's own domains point here
